006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.StaticMetapathException;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
010
011import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
012
013/**
014 * Resolves Metapath function signatures based on name and arity.
015 */
016@FunctionalInterface
017public interface IFunctionResolver {
018  /**
019   * Retrieve the function with the provided name that supports the signature of
020   * the provided methods.
021   *
022   * @param name
023   *          the name of a group of functions
024   * @param arity
025   *          the count of arguments for use in determining an argument signature
026   *          match
027   * @return the matching function
028   * @throws StaticMetapathException
029   *           with the code {@link StaticMetapathException#NO_FUNCTION_MATCH} if
030   *           a matching function was not found
031   */
032  @NonNull
033  IFunction getFunction(@NonNull IEnhancedQName name, int arity);
034}
